description: This file defines a Java class JsonJsonifiableSerializer that extends AbstractJsonifiableWithDittoHeadersSerializer to serialize and deserialize JsonObject instances to and from ByteBuffer, specifically for use with Eclipse Ditto's JSON structures. It uses string-based JSON encoding for data transfer.

classes.name: JsonJsonifiableSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for converting JsonObject instances to ByteBuffer and vice versa, tailored for usage with Eclipse Ditto's JSON structures.

methods.name: serializeIntoByteBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a JsonObject into a ByteBuffer by converting it to a JSON string and encoding it.

methods.name: deserializeFromByteBuffer
methods.description: Deserializes a ByteBuffer into a JsonValue by decoding the buffer into a JSON string and parsing it.
